sources.ref: NTA, JEE (Main) 2026 Session 2, B.E./B.Tech question paper 'B Tech 2nd Apr 2026 Shift 1' (English)
NTA, JEE (Main) 2026 Session 2 final answer key of B.E./B.Tech on which result compiled, Exam Date 02.04.2026, Shift First (page 1)

notes: Previous-year questions from NTA's JEE (Main) 2026 paper of 2 April 2026, Shift 1 (B.E./B.Tech), ingested with pyq-ingest. Stems, options, statements and list items keep NTA's English wording exactly; NTA published this paper in English only, so the Hindi is our translation (hi_source: translation) and must be reviewed as such. Answers are NTA's final key (result-compiled, Session 2); our own solutions reach the same answer for every question in this file. Question ids 9001 and up mark ingested PYQs.

stem.en: If the mean of the data $\begin{array}{|c|c|c|c|c|c|c|}\hline \text{Class} & 5\text{-}10 & 10\text{-}15 & 15\text{-}20 & 20\text{-}25 & 25\text{-}30 & 30\text{-}35 \\ \hline \text{Frequency} & 2 & k & 28 & 54 & k+1 & 5 \\ \hline \end{array}$ is $21$, then $k$ is one of the roots of the equation :
stem.hi: यदि आँकड़ों $\begin{array}{|c|c|c|c|c|c|c|}\hline \text{Class} & 5\text{-}10 & 10\text{-}15 & 15\text{-}20 & 20\text{-}25 & 25\text{-}30 & 30\text{-}35 \\ \hline \text{Frequency} & 2 & k & 28 & 54 & k+1 & 5 \\ \hline \end{array}$ का माध्य $21$ है, तो $k$ समीकरण का एक मूल है :

feynman.en: Use class marks as the representative values, set the weighted mean equal to $21$, solve for $k$, and test which equation it satisfies.
feynman.hi: वर्ग-चिह्नों को प्रतिनिधि मान लेकर भारित माध्य को $21$ के बराबर रखिए, $k$ निकालिए, और जाँचिए कि कौन-सा समीकरण संतुष्ट होता है।
